# SynchronizationAttractorBasin

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The set of initial conditions in the network state space that converge to a given synchronized state, whose boundaries shift with dynamic topology. Enables design of topology-aware routing and reconfiguration strategies that maintain coherent operation under dynamic link failures.
